steps.code: pip install torch · pip install -U text2vec

steps.en: Load a released Chinese model by its Hugging Face name
steps.zh: 按 Hugging Face 名字加载一个已发布的中文模型

steps.en: Downloads and caches the weights on first use, then runs locally
steps.zh: 首次使用时下载并缓存权重，之后在本地运行

steps.en: Encode your whole answer corpus once
steps.zh: 把整份答案库编码一次

steps.en: Turns each sentence into a fixed-length vector (768 numbers for the base model)
steps.zh: 把每句话变成一条定长向量（base 模型是 768 个数）

steps.en: Encode the user's question and search the corpus
steps.zh: 编码用户的问题，到答案库里搜

steps.en: Scores every corpus vector by cosine similarity and returns the top-k ids with scores
steps.zh: 用余弦相似度给每条答案打分，返回前 k 条的编号和分数

value.en: Chinese question matching works out of the box — no training set to collect and no retrieval service to run
value.zh: 中文问句匹配开箱即用：不用先攒训练集，也不用起一个检索服务

sources: https://github.com/shibing624/text2vec/blob/master/text2vec/similarity.py (semantic_search: score_function=cos_sim, corpora up to about 1 Million entries)
